Name: Ororon's Hoodie
Author: gwie
Description:
[size=3]Add 3 clothing articles based on Ororon's outfit from Genshin Impact.
Contains:
[/size][list]
[*][size=3]Ororon's Hood - Hats layer, ear included![/size]
[*][size=3]Ororon's Scarf - Accessories layer (recommended to put on slot 1)[/size]
[*][size=3]Ororon's Cape - Accessories layer (recommended to put on slot 2)[/size]
[/list][size=3]
That's it, anything else in the screenshot (hair, shirt, pants, boots) are vanilla items.[/size]

[b][size=3]This is my first SDV mod, that I made on a whim and thus unlikely to get maintained. Anyone is free to fork or use the content of this mod without my permission (except commercial use).[/size][/b]

Downloads.Description: 1.6 only. Other game versions are untested.
